title: diff: result
description: A worktree run's captured diff: git's binary diff from the base commit, exactly as the artifact store holds it, read and verified against its reference.

base.description: The commit the diff applies to.

patch.description: The diff itself. Absent: the run changed nothing.

encoding.description: How patch is written: utf-8 when its bytes are UTF-8 text, otherwise base64 of its bytes. Present exactly when patch is.
